scripts.api:export: rm -f openapi.json.tmp && KAHAWAI_SKIP_WEB_BUILD=1 cargo run --quiet -p kahawai-hub --example export_openapi -- openapi.json.tmp && node scripts/openapi-fingerprint.mjs --write openapi.json.tmp && KAHAWAI_OPENAPI=./openapi.json.tmp npm run api:client && mv openapi.json.tmp openapi.json
scripts.api:prepare: npm run api:check && npm run api:client
scripts.lint: oxlint --deny-warnings src test scripts orval.config.ts playwright.config.ts playwright.product.config.ts
scripts.fmt: oxfmt src test scripts orval.config.ts playwright.config.ts playwright.product.config.ts
scripts.fmt:check: oxfmt --check src test scripts orval.config.ts playwright.config.ts playwright.product.config.ts
